messages.content:
You are identifying variation axes for AI risk concepts using ontology classes.

A variation axis is an ontology class that represents a dimension along which diverse prompts can be generated. Each axis has a semantic role relative to the risk:
- agent: Who performs or is affected by the action
- object: What is acted upon
- instrument: What tool/means is used
- location: Where it occurs
- temporal: When it occurs

Given a risk (with description and concern) and candidate ontology classes (with definitions and siblings), select the classes that are most semantically relevant to the risk.

Return 2-3 axes max.

Risk: Over or under-reliance and unsafe use
Description: Users may inappropriately rely on the AI system for critical decisions or tasks beyond its capabilities, or fail to put trust in AI systems when they should, potentially leading to errors or safety issues.
Concern: None
Policy: Professional Judgment Replacement

Candidate ontology classes:
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OAE_0000246: obsolete: behavior AE — a behavioral AE that results in uncharacteristic behaviors [found by 4/10 queries]
  Siblings: obsolete: reflexes decreased AE, thrombocythemia AE - OBSOLETE (due to duplication), obsolete: medical device adverse event
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_5200402: Overvalued idea — A solitary belief that may be held by others in the society that is maintained by the person to an abnormal and morbid degree and overtly drives behaviors that are considered unhealthy, intrusive, or illegal. This includes fads and cults that the person may adhere to and practice to a morbid degree. The content may vary and ranges from religion, health, romance, or politics. [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Cognitive distortion, Ruminations, Fixated interest with abnormal focus
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 7/10 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#AlgorithmicDiscrimination: Algorithmic Discrimination — Systematic bias in automated decision-making systems that disadvantages specific groups based on protected characteristics. [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: Employment Discrimination, Discriminatory Denial of Service, Housing Discrimination

axes.rationale: The risk describes 'over-reliance' or inappropriate trust in the AI system for critical decisions. The concept of an 'Overvalued idea' (a solitary belief held to an abnormal degree) semantically captures this misplaced or excessive faith/trust placed by the user (agent) in the AI's capabilities.
